notes: Large-unit check: רָעַע + בְּ + עֵינֵי → 'was displeased' accounted morpheme by morpheme — no English word is spent on the preposition or on 'eyes' apart from the verb, so rule 40's fused idiom (אִם־רַע בְּעֵינֶיךָ → it displease) governs and the three-morpheme unit is retained; the rectum הָאֱלֹהִים keeps 'God' and its article is unrepresented.
